subject: INITIALIZE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB416.md LANDED -- the CONSEQUENCE half now holds, and it holds as a FUNNEL rather than as a check. identifier-1 resolves through ExpressionBinder.ResolveReceiving, the ONE receiving chokepoint, so it collects every receiving-operand prohibition that lives there: LINE-COUNTER (§8.4.3.15.3 SR3), a constant-name substituting a literal (§13.10.4 GR1), PAGE-COUNTER, a resolved-but-unimplemented receiver shape (COBOL0899, replacing the former run-time InitializeErrorAction staging -- §4.2.2 puts a syntax-rule violation in the compile-time mechanism), the OCCURS DYNAMIC CAPACITY register (§13.18.38 SR30-32) and a CONSTANT RECORD (§13.18.15.3 SR2 / COBOL1548). The routing rather than a bolted-on CONSTANT RECORD test is what makes the NEXT prohibition automatic, and a drift test asserts the routing survives. The DESIGNATION half was already correct and is unchanged (identifier-1 is a Place every expanded store writes through; a function-identifier is refused by the grammar, as §8.4.3.2.3 SR1 requires). Measured before: 'INITIALIZE CR.' over a CONSTANT RECORD compiled clean and destroyed the constant's content at run time. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Constants.cs#RejectConstantStore (kb/Work PB1418 turned the reporting RejectConstantStore into the non-reporting ConstantStoreProhibition, asked by ExpressionBinder.ReceivingPlaceBar (the place half of the receiving-prohibition table ResolveReceiving reports))
